name: Mini Cart for WooCommerce
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Mini Cart for WooCommerce is a lightweight and fast plugin that adds a floating, customizable mini cart icon to your WooCommerce store — complete with real-time AJAX updates, custom icon upload, and responsive design.

No coding needed. Just install, activate, and customize the appearance and behavior through a user-friendly admin panel.

🎯 Key Features

  • Enable or disable floating mini cart icon
  • Position control – bottom-left or bottom-right of the screen
  • Custom icon support – upload your own cart image or use default
  • Sticky cart visibility – stays on screen as users scroll
  • AJAX cart updates – real-time add/remove/modify without reload
  • Fully responsive – works on all screen sizes
  • Lightweight and optimized – no bloat, just performance

🎨 Design Customization

Easily match the cart to your site’s branding using color pickers:

Customizable Elements:

  • Mini cart background & text colors
  • Header background & text colors
  • Subtotal area styles
  • Cart and checkout button colors

🚀 Why Use Mini Cart for WooCommerce?

Give your customers a seamless cart experience. Keep the cart always accessible with instant updates and a clean UI — all without leaving the page or hurting site performance.

Support

Have questions or suggestions?
Visit the Support Forum or Contact the developer.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Mini Cart for WooCommerce
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Mini Cart Settings to customize options
sections.faq:
❓ Does this plugin use AJAX for cart updates?

Yes! It supports AJAX-powered add/remove/update actions for smooth, real-time interactions.

❓ Can I change the mini cart icon?

Yes. Upload your custom icon or choose from built-in options in the settings panel.

❓ Is it responsive and mobile-ready?

Absolutely. The mini cart layout adjusts seamlessly across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

❓ Are color settings customizable?

Yes, you can fully adjust all colors using built-in color pickers — no CSS needed.

❓ Will it work with any WooCommerce theme?

It works with all standard WooCommerce-compatible themes. Minor CSS tweaks may be required for heavily customized themes.

❓ Does it support variable products and quantity updates?

Yes. The plugin supports variable products and AJAX-based quantity changes.
